text:
jordan: Quick design check — compact alerting panel iteration. figma: https://figma.com/file/abc. Top header feels roomy; threshold helptext vague.
anya: Reduce top padding by 8px on desktop, tighten subtitle line-height.
sam: Agree. Also change 'percentage of errors' -> 'Percent of requests failing (5m)'. Clearer.
keith: A11y: warning color contrast is ~3.1:1; we need 4.5:1 for small text.
jordan: Noted. Channels: pills or dropdown? Pills show icons; dropdown saves width.
anya: Pills + overflow '+N' works if keyboard nav is solid and we show icons.
keith: Use role="listbox" + option semantics; include visible-hidden status text like '(suppressed)'.
sam: Preview placement: inline next to channels. Preview modal must trap focus and announce via aria-live.
aria-bot: Accessibility: preview modal should set role="dialog" aria-modal="true"; focus first interactive element; announce 'Notification preview opened' via aria-live polite.
jordan: Mobile nit: numeric stepper too close to label — add 6px left margin on widths <=480px.
anya: I'll update figma with pill + dropdown variants and compact copy tonight.
keith: I'll prototype aria attributes and keyboard navigation in the component lib branch.
sam: I'll run a contrast pass and post updated color tokens.
jordan: Plan: figma updates + a11y PR + color pass. Small canary after sign-off. :thumbsup:
